pages.title: Ring size guide
pages.body:
Our rings follow US sizing. Measure a ring that already fits the finger you have in mind, or wrap a strip of paper around the base of that finger and mark where it overlaps.

US sizeInner diameterCircumference
515.7 mm49.3 mm
616.5 mm51.9 mm
717.3 mm54.4 mm
818.1 mm57.0 mm
918.9 mm59.5 mm

Measure at the end of the day, when fingers are at their largest. For bands wider than 4 mm, such as our signets, choose half a size up.

Not sure? Order your best guess. Resizing is free within 30 days on solid gold and sterling silver.

pages.title: Materials and care
pages.body:
18k gold vermeil

A thick layer of 18k gold over recycled sterling silver: the look of gold at a lighter price. Take it off before swimming or the gym, and store it in its pouch.

18k solid gold

Recycled gold through and through. It never wears away, can be resized and is safe in water. Polish with a soft cloth.

Sterling silver

92.5% recycled silver with a soft, cool shine that deepens over time. Silver darkens with air; the cloth in your box brings it back.

pages.title: Shipping and returns
pages.body:
Free shipping in 2–4 business days. Every order arrives in our linen gift box with a card.

Free returns within 30 days of delivery. Engraved pieces are made for you and are final sale.

pages.title: Our story
pages.body:
Oriel began at a single bench by a north-facing window, with a block of carving wax and the idea that fine jewelry should be worn every day, not saved for later.

Every piece still starts the same way. We carve each design by hand in wax, cast it in recycled gold or silver, then file, polish and finish it in the studio. Because of that, no two hoops curve exactly alike, and we think that is the point.

We keep the collection small on purpose: around thirty pieces, each made to be layered, stacked and lived in for years. When something needs care, send it back. Cleaning and polishing are free for as long as you own the piece.

articles.title: How a hoop is carved
articles.summary: From a block of wax to a finished hoop: a week at the bench, step by step.
articles.body:
Every Sculpted hoop starts as a block of blue carving wax. We saw a ring from it, then shape the curve with files and a warm blade until it feels right in the hand, not just on paper.

The wax model goes into a flask of plaster. Once it sets, the flask is heated until the wax melts away and leaves a hollow in its exact shape. Molten recycled silver fills that hollow, and for vermeil pieces a thick layer of 18k gold is added after casting.

Then comes the slow part. Each hoop is filed, hammered for its faceted surface and polished in three stages. A single pair takes most of a day, which is why no two pairs are ever quite the same.

articles.title: Vermeil, solid gold or silver?
articles.summary: What each metal is, how it wears, and which one suits the way you live.
articles.body:
18k gold vermeil is a thick layer of 18k gold over recycled sterling silver. It gives you the warmth of gold at a lighter price. Take it off before swimming or the gym and it will keep its color for years.

18k solid gold is gold all the way through. It never wears away, it can be resized, and it is happy in water. It is the choice for pieces you never plan to take off.

Sterling silver is 92.5% recycled silver with a soft, cool shine. Air darkens it over time; the polishing cloth in every Oriel box brings it back in a minute.

Not sure? Many of our pieces come in two metals, so you can start in vermeil or silver and add solid gold later.

articles.title: Finding your ring size at home
articles.summary: Three simple ways to measure, and why signets need half a size more.
articles.body:
The easiest way is to measure a ring you already wear on the same finger. Lay it on a ruler and read the inner diameter in millimeters, then match it to our ring size guide.

No ring to hand? Wrap a thin strip of paper around the base of your finger, mark where it overlaps and measure the length. That is your circumference.

Measure at the end of the day, when fingers are slightly larger, and avoid cold hands. For wide bands like our signets, choose half a size up. And if it still is not right, resizing is free within 30 days on solid gold and sterling silver.

articles.title: Gifts that last
articles.summary: A short guide to choosing jewelry for someone else, from first birthdays to tenth anniversaries.
articles.body:
When you are not sure of their style, start with pieces that sit close to the body and go with everything: a fine chain, small studs or a thread ring. They are easy to wear every day, which is the best compliment a gift can get.

For anniversaries, signets and solid gold mark the moment. Add up to three initials or a date inside the band; engraving is free and every piece arrives in our linen gift box with a handwritten card.

Still undecided? A gift card lets them choose, and it never goes out of size.
